items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I left that group at the Tavern and joined Bernie Young.

ctx.x: Well, who else was in this band with you?

Bernie Young? Well, there's -- before he started out on guitar -- in fact he started out on the ukelele, and he used to tune his guitar up as a ukelele. We made him stop that and let him tune it up the way it should be. It was Mike McKendrick.
